name: Plank
steps: Lie face down on the floor, place your forearms flat on the ground with your elbows directly under your shoulders, and tuck your toes under.
Lift your body off the floor so you balance on your forearms and toes in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs firmly, squeeze your glutes, and gently pull your elbows toward your toes without moving them to create full-body tension.
Hold the position steadily while breathing evenly for the target duration, then lower your knees gently to finish.
tips: Keep your hips level with your shoulders rather than letting your lower back sag or piking your hips high.
Look at the floor between your forearms to keep your neck aligned with your spine.
